EVIDENCE BEFORE RELEASE

Partial Success

Partial Success workflow for coding agents. Use when some checks passed and others failed.

Workflow

  1. Identify the requested outcome and supplied evidence.
  2. Name every pass and failure; separate observed symptoms from possible causes.
  3. Verify the output contract and preserve uncertainty.

Populated example

Request: Lint and units passed; auth integration returned 401.

Lint and unit tests passed. Integration failed with 401; cause unconfirmed.

Use the helper

summarize_checks

Source: skills/partial-success/SKILL.md in the package. Use this workflow selectively; it does not override user or system instructions.
